title: Guards and null in a pattern switch

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Per this page, what part does `case null` play in whether a pattern switch is exhaustive?

options.text: A full part: no switch is exhaustive without it
options.says: The page says null plays no part in exhaustiveness checking.

options.text: A part only when the switch is over a sealed type
options.says: The page says a switch can be exhaustive without case null, sealed type or not.

options.text: No part: a switch can be exhaustive without it
options.says: The page says null plays no part in exhaustiveness checking; a switch can be exhaustive without case null.

questions.stem: Per this page, when is the condition after `when` in a case evaluated?

options.text: Only after the case's pattern has matched
options.says: The page says guards are evaluated only if the pattern matches.

options.text: Just before the pattern, to skip its type test
options.says: The page says a guard is evaluated only once its pattern has matched, not before.

options.text: Once only, when the switch is first entered
options.says: The page says a guard is evaluated for its case, after that case's pattern matches.

concepts: A guard is evaluated only after its pattern has matched, and may use the pattern's variables.
case null plays no part in exhaustiveness: a switch can be exhaustive without it.
